tasks.label: Deploy: Device Gateway API
tasks.detail: Triggers GitHub Actions ci.yml to redeploy DeviceGatewayApi to the shared dev environment. Requires `gh` CLI authenticated to the repo.

tasks.label: Deploy: Operator API
tasks.detail: Triggers ci.yml for OperatorApi.

tasks.label: Deploy: Imaging Core API
tasks.detail: Triggers ci.yml for ImagingCoreApi.

tasks.label: Deploy: Portal Backend
tasks.detail: Triggers ci.yml for the Portal backend App Service.

tasks.label: Deploy: Portal Frontend
tasks.detail: Triggers ci.yml for the Portal frontend Static Web App.

tasks.label: Deploy: All components
tasks.detail: Triggers ci.yml to build/test/deploy ALL components to the shared dev environment. Infrastructure (Bicep) is deployed separately via the 'IaC: Publish Template Spec' task.

tasks.label: Build: .NET Solution (Release)
tasks.detail: Build all .NET projects in Release configuration with TreatWarningsAsErrors.

tasks.label: Build: Client WPF (Release)
tasks.detail: Build the CloudImaging.Client WPF app in Release configuration.

tasks.label: Build: Media Builder WPF (Release)
tasks.detail: Build the CloudImaging.MediaBuilder WPF app in Release configuration.

tasks.label: Build: Client WPF (Debug)
tasks.detail: Build the CloudImaging.Client WPF app in Debug configuration.

tasks.label: Build: Media Builder WPF (Debug)
tasks.detail: Build the CloudImaging.MediaBuilder WPF app in Debug configuration (enables DEV_SIMULATION mode).

tasks.label: Build: Both WPF apps (Debug)
tasks.detail: Build both the Cloud Imaging Client and Media Builder WPF apps in Debug configuration.

tasks.label: Publish: Client WPF (self-contained win-x64)
tasks.detail: Publish CloudImaging.Client as a self-contained win-x64 deployment (bundles its own .NET runtime), matching the release pipeline. Required for WinPE boot images — a plain Build output is framework-dependent and fails inside WinPE with 'You must install .NET Desktop Runtime to run this application.' Output: publish/Client.

tasks.label: Publish: Media Builder WPF (self-contained win-x64)
tasks.detail: Publish CloudImaging.MediaBuilder as a self-contained win-x64 deployment (bundles its own .NET runtime), matching the release pipeline. Output: publish/MediaBuilder.

tasks.label: Publish: Both WPF apps (self-contained win-x64)
tasks.detail: Publish both the Cloud Imaging Client and Media Builder WPF apps as self-contained win-x64 deployments.

tasks.label: Test: .NET Solution
tasks.detail: Run all .NET unit and integration tests.

tasks.label: IaC: Publish Template Spec to dev
tasks.detail: Publish the Bicep + uiFormDefinition.json as a Template Spec to your dev resource group.

tasks.label: Update: Run upgrade script (local archive)
tasks.detail: Dry-run the community upgrade script against the dev resource group. Remove -WhatIf to deploy.

tasks.label: Dev: Run portal server (localhost:3000)
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; cd src/cloud-imaging-portal/server; npm run dev
tasks.detail: Kill any process already listening on port 3000, then start the portal Express server in watch mode. Requires VITE_ENTRA_CLIENT_ID etc. in .env.

tasks.label: Dev: Run portal client (Vite, localhost:5173)
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; cd src/cloud-imaging-portal/client; npm run dev
tasks.detail: Kill any process already listening on port 5173 (avoids Vite falling back to 5174, which breaks the registered SPA redirect URI), then start the Vite dev server. Requires VITE_ENTRA_CLIENT_ID / VITE_ENTRA_AUTHORITY in .env.

tasks.label: Test: Portal client (vitest)
tasks.detail: Run portal frontend unit tests via Vitest.

tasks.label: Test: Portal server (vitest)
tasks.detail: Run portal server unit tests via Vitest.

tasks.label: Lint: Portal client (ESLint)
tasks.detail: Run ESLint over the React portal client.

tasks.label: Lint: Portal server (ESLint)
tasks.detail: Run ESLint over the Express portal server.

tasks.label: Release: Verify no secrets/config committed
tasks.detail: Release gate: fails if any committed appsettings.json still contains environment values, or if a *.Local.json / *.Development.json / .env / local.settings.json overlay is tracked by git. Run before publishing a public release.

tasks.label: Release: Push Backend/IaC tag (mse-ci-v#.#.#)
tasks.command: git fetch origin main --tags; git tag mse-ci-v${input:releaseVersion} origin/main; git push origin mse-ci-v${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: Tags origin/main's tip (not local HEAD, so it always points at what's actually on GitHub) mse-ci-v<version> and pushes it, triggering release-iac.yml (3 Function Apps + portal + deploy scripts). A version with no '-' suffix also moves the mse-ci-iac-latest alias.

tasks.label: Release: Push Client tag (mse-ci-client-v#.#.#)
tasks.command: git fetch origin main --tags; git tag mse-ci-client-v${input:releaseVersion} origin/main; git push origin mse-ci-client-v${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: Tags origin/main's tip (not local HEAD) mse-ci-client-v<version> and pushes it, triggering release-client.yml (CloudImaging.Client). A version with no '-' suffix also moves the mse-ci-client-latest alias that Media Builder's 'Automatic download' resolves.

tasks.label: Release: Push Media Builder tag (mse-ci-mediabuilder-v#.#.#)
tasks.command: git fetch origin main --tags; git tag mse-ci-mediabuilder-v${input:releaseVersion} origin/main; git push origin mse-ci-mediabuilder-v${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: Tags origin/main's tip (not local HEAD) mse-ci-mediabuilder-v<version> and pushes it, triggering release-mediabuilder.yml (CloudImaging.MediaBuilder). No 'latest' alias for this stream (nothing auto-downloads it).

tasks.label: Dev: Simulate device session
tasks.detail: Simulates a Cloud Imaging Client CreateSession request against the Device Gateway API using the boot-media PFX (mTLS + proof-of-possession), without building/running the WPF client. Add -SimulateEdgeHeader in the script to hit a Function host directly.

inputs.description: Path to the boot-media PFX (exported without password)
